date.as_written: varṣe śailasaripatībharajanīkāṃtair mite tīkṣṇagau kanyārāśim upāgate ʼmaladale some vivasvattithau

notes: The chronogram is śaila (7) - saritpati (4) - ibha (8) - rajanīkānta (1) = 1847 (Vikrama Samvat). The catalogue erroneously lists Avanīdeva as scribe and Śivanidhi as donor; the colophon clearly states that Śivanidhi, the son of Avanīdeva (avanidevajaḥ śivanidhiḥ), copied the manuscript by order of the Regent Bahadur Shah (yuvabhūpati bahādūra). Vivasvattithi refers to dvādaśī (12 Adityas).
